caseName: Marine Corps Exchange v. Director, Office of Workers' Compensation Programs
caseNameFull: Marine Corps Exchange v. Director, Office of Workers' Compensation Programs, United States Department of Labor

opinions.text: C. A. 9th Cir. Motion of respondent Elton Morgan for approval of attorney’s fees is denied without prejudice to applying for the relief in the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit. Certiorari denied.
